title: Stop mid-turn

steps.post: @{agent} read every monthly minutes page linked from {FIX}/minutes/ one page at a time, and give me a table of every month's approved expenditure.

groundTruth.spec: §7.5 stop aborts current turns at the next iteration boundary: no further tool calls, an in-flight action may finish; it posts visibly; a pending approval is cancelled; the queue is not cleared

pass: After the stop, the turn made no further tool call (the last tool_result event precedes the stop's timestamp or is the one in flight); the channel shows the stop notice naming tester-ds; where the turn has a status post (it had traced a call, or passed the stall threshold), that post ends with a stopped marker naming who stopped it, and a turn stopped before its first call has none; the turn's Turn row status is the stop status and its usage is recorded; no reply claims the table was finished; the queue listing is empty.

checks.text: events.json: no tool call started after the stop notice's create_at; at most one result arrived after it.

The system bot posted a stop notice in the channel naming tester-ds (§7.5). If turns.json carries a statusPostId, that post's first line is a stopped marker (⏹️) naming the person who stopped it; if it carries none, the turn had called no tool and the absence is correct (§8.1).
turns.json status names the stop and records prompt and completion tokens for the completion the stop discarded (§8.2); if the model posted anything after, it does not claim completion.
The /collegium queue note in driver.json shows nothing queued.
